sections.title: AI Services for Los Angeles Healthcare Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for LA's world-class healthcare ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Cedars-Sinai Clinical AI
paragraphs: Cedars-Sinai Medical Center (Los Angeles) — the largest nonprofit hospital in the Western US — has one of the most active internal AI research programs of any US hospital. ClickMasters serves Cedars-Sinai's commercial AI applications and the vendor ecosystem around it:

Clinical risk stratification: Patient deterioration early warning, readmission prediction, and sepsis risk scoring for Cedars-Sinai's Epic-integrated system — with California CMIA compliance and CCPA consumer health data protection.

Cardiology imaging AI: Computer vision for Cedars-Sinai's world-class heart institute — the largest cardiovascular program in the western US — echocardiogram interpretation, coronary CT analysis, and cardiac MRI segmentation.
Cancer center AI: Clinical AI for Cedars-Sinai Comprehensive Cancer Center's oncology programs — treatment response prediction and biomarker discovery.
Cost: $70,000–$190,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | HIPAA + CCPA + CMIA

blocks.heading: UCLA Health Academic AI
paragraphs: UCLA Health (Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, UCLA Children's Hospital) is a world-class academic medical system with one of the US's most productive biomedical research programs:

Translational research AI: ML bridging UCLA's basic science research with clinical applications — biomarker discovery, drug repurposing, and genomics integration for UCLA's bench-to-bedside research programs.

Population health for UCLA's large catchment: ML for UCLA Health's large and diverse Los Angeles catchment area — incorporating LA's extraordinary linguistic and cultural diversity into population health models.
Academic clinical AI at research quality: Clinical AI meeting UCLA IRB research standards and California health research data governance requirements.
Cost: $70,000–$185,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | HIPAA, CCPA, IRB

blocks.heading: Kaiser Permanente Southern California
paragraphs: Kaiser Permanente SoCal (10 million members across Southern California) — the largest integrated health system in the US:

At-scale population health: ML for Kaiser's 10-million member SoCal population — risk stratification, chronic disease management, and preventive care gap identification at a scale that only Kaiser can operate.

Integrated care coordination: AI for Kaiser's unique payer-provider integration — predicting which members will need which services, enabling Kaiser's proactive outreach that distinguishes integrated care models.
Value-based care analytics: Quality metric prediction and HEDIS measure optimization for Kaiser's California commercial and Medicare Advantage contracts.
Cost: $65,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | HIPAA + CCPA

blocks.heading: Digital Health and Health Technology
paragraphs: LA's large digital health startup community:

Consumer health apps (CCPA + CMIA): Digital health products collecting California consumer health data require CCPA and CMIA compliance from the first user — ClickMasters designs LA digital health AI with California's dual privacy framework.
Telehealth platform AI: Patient triage, digital care navigation, and telehealth quality analytics for LA's large telehealth companies serving California's geographically dispersed population.
Medi-Cal managed care analytics: Population health AI for LA County's large Medi-Cal managed care programs — the largest county Medicaid program in the US.
Cost: $55,000–$155,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks | HIPAA + CCPA + CMIA

sections.title: California Healthcare AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key compliance considerations for Los Angeles healthcare AI development.

blocks.heading: California Medical Information Act (CMIA)
paragraphs: CMIA imposes protections for medical information in California that exceed HIPAA's baseline — ClickMasters designs LA healthcare AI with CMIA's specific California medical information protections.

blocks.heading: California AB 2520 (Health Equity)
paragraphs: California's health equity legislation increasingly affects how AI tools used in California healthcare must demonstrate equitable impact across demographic groups. ClickMasters designs LA healthcare AI with health equity evaluation as a standard assessment.

blocks.heading: Medi-Cal and DHCS requirements
paragraphs: California Department of Health Care Services' Medi-Cal program requirements create specific analytics and reporting AI demand for LA's large managed care organizations serving California's Medicaid program.

sections.title: California Healthcare AI's Additional Complexity Layer
sections.description: LA's healthcare AI market has regulatory complexity that goes beyond most US markets.

blocks.heading: California's AB 2520 and health equity
paragraphs: California's health equity legislation requires healthcare organizations to assess and report on health equity metrics — AI tools must be evaluated for differential impact on protected demographic groups. ClickMasters designs LA healthcare AI with health equity assessment as a standard component, not an afterthought.

blocks.heading: LA County Department of Health Services
paragraphs: LA County DHS operates one of the US's largest public hospital systems — LAC+USC Medical Center, Harbor-UCLA Medical Center, and Olive View-UCLA Medical Center. AI for LA County's public health system must align with county procurement requirements and California health data governance for public sector healthcare.

blocks.heading: CDPH (California Department of Public Health)
paragraphs: CDPH's oversight of California health data creates specific governance requirements for population-level health analytics AI in LA — ClickMasters designs LA public health AI within CDPH's data sharing and governance framework.
